name: ProjectMind for Hermes Agent (Nous Research)
description: Autonomous project intelligence, Native MCP client integration, HERMES.md instruction file, and self-improving memory loop.

capabilities.restartInstructions: Hermes Agent hot-reloads skills and HERMES.md; restart hermes or run `hermes mcp list` to verify.
documentedLimitations: Hermes Agent prioritizes HERMES.md over AGENTS.md when both are present. ProjectMind installs into both to guarantee discoverability across all sessions.

installationInstructions: Run `projectmind plugin install hermes-agent` in your project root.
upgradeInstructions: Run `projectmind plugin update hermes-agent` to refresh configs, skills, and hooks.
removalInstructions: Run `projectmind plugin uninstall hermes-agent` to cleanly remove integration while preserving project knowledge.
